query:
SELECT n.id
        FROM notes n
        WHERE n.owner_id = $1
          AND ($3 OR NOT n.is_archived)
          AND ((n.title || ' ' || n.search_text) ILIKE $5
               OR word_similarity($2, n.title || ' ' || n.search_text) > 0.3)
        ORDER BY ((n.title || ' ' || n.search_text) ILIKE $5) DESC,
                 word_similarity($2, n.title || ' ' || n.search_text) DESC,
                 n.id DESC
        LIMIT $4
